thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ⛔ P2 - CascadeCorp (VPC) — model error-rate spike > 12% and 95th latency > 3s. Affected: dedicated pool cc-vpc-pool-7, tenant cascadecorp-prod. Pager routed to oncall. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/vpc-degradation

maya-oncall: I’m on it — taking ownership. Paging SRE and Eng. Can someone confirm if this is KV cache thrashing or network egress?

jamie-sre: looking at metrics now — KC and runtime both show token latency rising around 23:44 UTC. Errors are 5xx model rejections (OOM-like) not gateway 502s. Logs: `model-worker-7` showing repeated `RuntimeError: not enough memory for allocate` followed by retry/backoff. Pushing logs here: https://logs.redwood/trace/cc/1734567890

arjun-eng: thanks. Cascade model v3.2 was rolled to the pool yesterday. We have q4 quantized safe variant `cascade-safe-v1` available. Suggest pin tenant to safe variant and divert new requests to dedicated fallback while we debug v3.2 mem pattern.

lee-se: CascadeCorp reporting elevated user failures via support. Customer asks for a fast mitigation — pinning to safe variant is acceptable to them if it stabilizes latency. They prefer no full rollback if possible.

emily-cs: I’ve told the customer we’ll apply a temporary safe-variant pin and will follow up with timeline. CC: account team on this thread.

maya-oncall: jamie, can you run the tenant pin now? I'll coordinate routing and canary.

jamie-sre: executing tenant policy change — calling internal admin API. Command:```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/tenants/cascadecorp/policy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model_fallback": "cascade-safe-v1", "pin_override": true, "rollout_pct": 100}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-job/98765 started by jamie-sre — applying tenant policy change. CI checks passed.

ops-alert-bot: Notice: traffic drain to pool cc-vpc-pool-7 at 1734567985 UTC due to policy update. New routing will respect pinned model and route to pool cc-safepool-2 where safe variant is hosted.

jamie-sre: policy change accepted (request id req_0a3f). Sample response: `{"status":"ok","applied_to":"cascadecorp","new_model":"cascade-safe-v1","effective_at":1734567990}`

maya-oncall: switching canary to 5% for 10m then to 100% if stable. Canary step started at 23:46 UTC. Monitoring: error-rate and 95p latency.

jamie-sre: immediate logs show worker restarts stop and memory usage drops on safepool. Sample metric snapshot: `error_rate: 0.9% -> 0.3%`, `95p_latency: 3.2s -> 1.1s` within 2m.

lee-se: customer confirms throughput looks normal from their side, errors appear reduced. They asked whether we’ll backfill any missed requests — we told them we’ll check traces and surface any user-facing failures.

arjun-eng: we should still collect heap dumps and GPU memory traces for v3.2 to find leak pattern. I'll open a dev ticket and assign to the model-onboarding team. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/ML-1246

emily-cs: noted. I’ll set up a customer post-incident update for EOD, include cause, mitigation, and ETA for root-cause.

maya-oncall: handoff: I’m handing this to night-oncall (reza-oncall) for monitoring after 00:30 UTC if stable. If any spike > 5% again, re-escalate to oncall immediately.

jamie-sre: we’ll keep the safe-variant pin until v3.2 root-cause is fixed and validated. Proposed rollback plan: 1) fix memory leak, 2) internal canary on testpool, 3) 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% rollouts across dedicated pools with 30m observation windows.

maya-oncall: summary of actions taken: applied tenant pin to `cascade-safe-v1` at 1734567990, diverted traffic to `cc-safepool-2`, canary to 5% then 100% after stability. Escalated model ticket ML-1246 to eng. Customer informed.

lee-se: customer requested opt-in for proactive safepinning for next two weeks while we perform root cause analysis. Can product/legal comment on policy? (cc @product-ops)

arjun-eng: from eng side we can enable temporary safepin window per-tenant. We’ll need an admin flag and expiry timestamp. I’ll add to ML-1246.

emily-cs: I’ve scheduled a 1:1 with the TAM for CascadeCorp at 1400 PST tomorrow. Will include rollback/restore plan and compensation if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-job/98765 completed — policy applied successfully across control plane nodes.

ops-alert-bot: Monitoring note: baseline error rate for cascadecorp-prod now 0.4% at 1734568120 UTC; 95p latency 1.05s.

maya-oncall: closing active pager for now — leaving followup tasks and owner list in the ticket. Night oncall (reza) to watch for regressions. Postmortem assigned to jamie-sre & arjun-eng — draft due in 72h.

jamie-sre: quick log excerpt for postmortem:```text
23:42:11 model-worker-7 OOMAllocError: attempted allocate 1.9GiB; available 512MiB
23:42:12 worker restart -> retry
23:44:03 repeated allocations -> eviction thrash
23:45:50 safe-variant routing applied -> cluster stabilizes
```

emily-cs: thanks team — customer grateful for quick mitigation. I’ll send update now.

maya-oncall: resolved for now. Will leave thread open for additional findings. :thumbsup:
